title: Reference-Grafting Matches Fine-Tuning at Eliciting Sandbagged Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2608.29458v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sandbagging, in which a model deliberately underperforms on an evaluation despite retaining the underlying capability, threatens the safety evaluations that frontier-model governance depends on. The Elicitation Game found that fine-tuning elicits hidden capability from sandbagging model organisms whereas additive activation steering fails. We revisit that verdict with reference-grafting, which sets an activation's coordinate along a contrast direction to the value it takes in an honest reference, at a small set of circuits chosen by active learning. Across eleven fine-tuned password-locked models (1.5-32B, three architecture lineages), it recovers +94 to +101% of the honest-sandbagging gap, matching fine-tuning elicitation without weight updates or training labels; two to five paired examples suffice to fit the direction. Similar recovery holds for reinforcement-learning-induced sandbagging and for password-locked code generation. Graf

translated_title: 参照嫁接法在引出被隐藏能力方面媲美微调
translated_abstract: 沙袋行为（sandbagging）指模型尽管保留了底层能力，却在评估中故意表现不佳，这威胁到前沿模型治理所依赖的安全评估。“引出博弈”研究发现，微调能够从沙袋化的模型样本中引出隐藏能力，而加性激活引导则失败了。我们通过参照嫁接法重新审视了这一结论：该方法将激活在某个对比方向上的坐标设置为诚实的参照模型中的取值，并作用于由主动学习选出的少量电路。在十一个经过微调的密码锁定模型上（1.5B-32B，涵盖三种架构谱系），该方法恢复了诚实-沙袋差距的 +94% 到 +101%，在无需权重更新或训练标签的情况下媲美微调引出；仅需两到五个成对样本即可拟合该方向。对于强化学习诱导的沙袋行为以及密码锁定的代码生成任务，也取得了类似的恢复效果。
tldr: 提出参照嫁接方法，仅需2-5个成对样本且无需更新权重或训练标签，即可在多种沙袋化模型上恢复94%-101%的隐藏能力差距，效果媲美微调引出。
en_tdlr: Reference-grafting recovers 94–101% of the hidden capability gap in sandbagged models—matching fine-tuning-based elicitation—without any weight updates or training labels, using only 2–5 paired examples.
